seo.title.t: Our story · Meet Ana, the founder of Picnic Club

seo.description.t: Picnic Club was born on the coast between Comporta and Alcácer do Sal, from Ana’s love of beautiful places and thoughtful hospitality.

lead.t: Born and raised on this coastline, Ana curates luxury picnics, proposals and intimate celebrations designed around every guest.

story.0.t: After several years away from home, Ana had the chance to travel, to discover exceptional places and to experience hospitality at its finest. Every beautiful setting and every thoughtful detail became a source of inspiration.

story.1.t: Coming back to Alcácer do Sal, she realised that Comporta, Tróia and the coast around them deserved experiences that felt just as refined, effortless and memorable as the ones she had admired elsewhere. The first picnics found an audience so quickly that she left her career in banking to devote herself to them.

quote.t: It is never just a beautiful table. It is an entire experience.
